claim: The sample demo does not read or change real recipes, licenses, or signing keys, and Reset demo restores its sample.
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed real storage sentinels; issue and reset a demo receipt; assert sentinels and real IndexedDB are untouched

claim: CSV planning, verification, and receipt signing do not upload metadata or use tracking.
sandbox: fresh demo context; record requests through planning, verification, and signing; assert every request is same-origin

claim: The demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load /demo; wait for service-worker control; set the context offline; reload and assert populated sample output

claim: The workbench plans date, caption, keyword, and IPTC-column changes.
sandbox: fresh demo context; exercise keyword append, date shift, caption set, and an IPTCHeadline set; assert changed values

claim: The app leaves the selected source CSV unchanged and creates a separate planned CSV.
sandbox: fresh demo context; upload a known CSV; export a plan; reread the selected file and compare both contents

claim: Every intended change in the 10,000-row boundary fixture appears exactly once.
sandbox: fresh demo context; upload 10,000 unique rows; export changes; assert 10,000 rows and 10,000 unique identities

claim: The free workflow exports complete changes, planned-value, and exception CSV files.
sandbox: fresh demo context; download all three CSV outputs; assert headers, four changes, five planned rows, and the blank-identity exception

claim: A later CSV is checked against every planned change, with missing, duplicate, and mismatched rows listed as exceptions.
sandbox: fresh demo context; load a later CSV containing a mismatch, duplicate, and missing row; assert the exported reasons

claim: The free workflow exports an ECDSA P-256 signed receipt that verifies with its public verification file.
sandbox: fresh demo context; issue both receipt files; assert the signature envelope and verify it through the public-file UI

claim: The public verification file detects a receipt payload changed after signing.
sandbox: fresh demo context; alter a signed before/after value; verify it with the original public material; assert a signature mismatch

claim: Real receipts reuse a private signing key stored in this browser's IndexedDB.
sandbox: fresh context entered through /demo; start for real; sign before and after reload; assert the same key ID and local IndexedDB

claim: Plus costs USD $19 as a one-time purchase with no subscription.
where: first screen, Plus section, terms page, README
sandbox: fresh demo entry; open the real offer link; assert the hosted checkout reports one_time_price, USD, and 1900 minor units

claim: A saved license is checked with Sociobot at most once per day.
sandbox: fresh context entered through /demo; intercept a successful verification; reload twice; assert exactly one API check and URL token removal

claim: A valid Plus license adds local saved recipes, receipt notes, and a separate JSON evidence export.
sandbox: fresh context entered through /demo; use a recorded valid-license response; save a recipe; export a noted receipt and the JSON evidence
